basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | project scientist: Essential Criteria: B.Tech or B.E. in CSE / Electronics / Mechanical having 1st class or equivalent in the appropriate discipline with 2 years of relevant work experience in the relevant field.Desirable Criteria: Solid conceptual as well as hands-on understanding of modern machine learning/deep learning techniques. Prior experience with deep neural networks for visual recognition tasks such as image classification, object detection, or semantic segmentation.

salary_details.details: The consolidated fellowship/pay slab includes HRA at 30% as specified in the official notification. In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec.
Fill out the application form completely with information regarding educational qualifications indicating percentage of marks, division, details of work experience, etc.
Send the filled application form by email along with Advertisement No. on the subject line.
Email the application to Prof. Chetan Arora at email id: [email protected].
Ensure the completed application reaches by email on or before 21/10/2026 by 5:00 p.m.
important_instructions: Appointment shall be on contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The project is funded by Larsen & Toubro Precision Engineering & Systems, Mumbai. Department of Computer Science & Engineering manages the project under Principal Investigator Prof. Chetan Arora. Duration of the project is up to 04/01/2028. 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview. IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment about?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Project Scientist posts at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi under the Industrial Research & Development Unit.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Scientist post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting completed applications by email is 21/10/2026 by 5:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.Tech or B.E. in CSE/Electronics/Mechanical having 1st class or equivalent in the appropriate discipline with 2 years of relevant work experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates need to download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website and email the completed application along with the advertisement number in the subject line to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The consolidated fellowship/pay slab ranges from Rs. 47,790 to 62,350/- p.m. plus HRA @30% depending on the pay slab stage.

faq.question: Q8. Who is the Principal Investigator for this project?
faq.answer: Prof. Chetan Arora from the Department of Computer Science & Engineering is the Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an upper age limit specified?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an upper age limit.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the project?
faq.answer: The duration of the project is up to 04/01/2028.
